result.rationale: The migration inserts legacy embeddable_hosts values verbatim (INSERT ... VALUES ('#{h}', ...)) with no normalization, while EmbeddableHost.record_for_host does an exact match: where("lower(host) = ?", host). The stripping of http:// and paths only happens in the model's before_validation on save. So migrated rows like 'http://example.com' or entries with paths/whitespace would never match, breaking existing embeds — a real defect introduced by the diff.

adjudication.rationale: The migration copies legacy `embeddable_hosts` lines directly into the new `embeddable_hosts.host` column via raw SQL (`INSERT ... VALUES ('#{h}', ...)`), bypassing the model’s `before_validation` normalization that strips `http(s)://` and paths. The new matching logic (`EmbeddableHost.record_for_host` extracts `uri.host` and then queries `where("lower(host) = ?", host)`) expects stored values to be just the hostname. If the old setting contained entries like `http://example.com` or `https://example.com/123` (which the removed `SiteSetting.allows_embeddable_host?` previously supported), those migrated rows would not match and embeds could break after upgrade.
